svg.title: Harbour Office Supplies: proposed database architecture
svg.desc: Proposed PostgreSQL primary and standby, MongoDB replica set, event publisher and separate backup store. This system has not been deployed.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Harbour Office Supplies | Proposed components only
